svg.text: LLM judge: catches planted anti-patterns, quiet on twins?
Frozen judge (claude-opus-5-5, 3 runs, majority vote). Seeds = planted anti-patterns; twins = the same edit without the defect.
Catch: the judge fails the unit holding the planted anti-pattern
ORM mapping on a domain class
Bars: proportion; whiskers: 95% Wilson interval. Each catch is judge-only on E1 and the fixture: no symbolic rule fired on those seeds.
Read it as construct sensitivity, not a detection rate: 35 seeds, 10 of round 1 on one 8-file fixture, and the DUP-RULE catch is confounded
with a "foreign method" cue (the judge also fails a service that only gains an unrelated method).
Round 1: Docs/DiagnosticRuns/v1.3-judge-catch-2026-10-15.md §3 · Round 2: Docs/DiagnosticRuns/v1.3-judge-catch-round2-2026-10-15.md §3 · DUP-RULE v2 and pooled:
